verdict.rationale: The agentic commerce docs cover catalog search, carts, checkout, buyer handoff, order state via get_order, and order webhooks for refunds, returns, exchanges, edits and cancellations. Nothing in the pack documents a dispute or chargeback API, evidence submission, or dispute status and outcomes. Refund and return notifications are an adjacent capability and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, disputes and chargebacks on agent transactions can be handled via API — evidence submission, status, outcomes
